thread:
maria-cs: Quick weekly health check for Veridian Health — following up on last week's escalation INC-2025-832. They had 3 repeat incidents overnight. p95 latency jumped to ~780ms (baseline ~340ms). Spend up ~12% from retries. Need clear owners for RCA, interim mitigations, and customer update.

sam-eng: I saw the same traces. Looks like KV-cache thrash when sequence lengths spike. Two traces tie back to the same config combo from the rollout on 03/04. I can take RCA.

jordan-ops: I will pull autoscaler and node churn logs now. Suspect transient pod restarts due to OOMs during those bursts. Will share logs in this thread.

elaine-cs: I'll own the customer comms and coordinate a 30-min sync if needed. Suggest an interim note: transparent update + mitigation plan + ask for a safe window for a brief canary test.

adam-support: We applied a temporary throttling patch on the dedicated pool last night which reduced retries. Error rate dropped from ~4.2% -> 1.1% in the canary, latency median improved but p95 still elevated. Continuing to monitor.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2025-832 status changed to "in progress" (assigned: sam-eng). Links: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2025-832

sam-eng: RCA plan: 1) reproduce locally with seq-length distribution, 2) confirm KV cache eviction pattern, 3) test a small quantization rollback and cache-size bump. ETA Thu EOD.

jordan-ops: Logs: autoscaler showed 6 scale-ups in 10m window, 4 pods restarted. Attaching snippet:

```
2025-03-10T02:14:21Z pod/redwood-infer-9 OOMKilled
2025-03-10T02:14:23Z pod/redwood-infer-11 Ready
2025-03-10T02:18:07Z scaler/autoscaler scale_to=12 reason=cpu_burst
```

elaine-cs: Drafting customer note now. Outline: acknowledge repeat incidents, summarize what we saw, immediate mitigation (throttle + canary), RCA in progress, propose Wed/Thu 30-min call. Will post draft here for review.

adam-support: Monitoring dashboard: error-rate panel pinned, will report back in 4h. If it stays <1.5% for 48h we can call the canary successful.

maria-cs: Action items recap — Sam (RCA) by Thu EOD; Jordan (full autoscaler + pod-restart logs) by EOD today; Adam (monitor for 48h + dashboard alerts); Elaine (customer note + propose call). I'll schedule the call once Elaine posts draft. Please add any blockers. :thumbsup:

elaine-cs: Draft posted (see below). Please quick review by EOD, Sam make sure we don't promise timelines beyond RCA.

```
Hi Veridian team,
We wanted to update you on the repeated latency spikes. We've identified correlated config rollouts and transient node churn as likely contributors. We're running an RCA and have a mitigation in place that reduced errors in a canary. Proposed next steps: 1) continue monitoring (48h), 2) run controlled canary test in a low-traffic window, 3) follow up with RCA and permanent fix. Can we schedule 30 minutes Wed/Thu for a short sync?
Thanks, Elaine (Redwood CS)
```

sam-eng: LGTM, minor wording tweak: replace "likely contributors" with "probable contributors".

maria-cs: Thanks team. I'll follow up with the calendar invite once Elaine finalizes wording. If anyone sees another repeat, ping here immediately. :eyes:
